question: Construction work has begun in Lincolnshire on the world's longest subsea power cable, which will run between Britain and ______ to share renewable energy between the two countries.
solution:
The correct answer is** Denmark.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​**

__
 
• Foreign ties between the** United Kingdom and Denmark **are known as **British-Danish relations**. Denmark and the United Kingdom each have embassies in the other's capital cities.
 
• The **1.6 billion euro North Sea Link** is referred to as "the world's longest undersea electrical interconnector" by** Britain's National Grid.**
 
• The NSL's goal is to utilize both the** U.S. and Norway's hydropower. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• The **U.K. and Norway **can now share renewable energy thanks to a** 450-mile underwater connection **that connects the two nations.
 
• The **NSL's goal is to utilise the hydropower in Norway **and wind energy in the United Kingdom.
 
• **Hydroelectricity from Norway** can be imported when demand is high in Britain but wind generation is low.
